design: Prespecified diagnostic/reference/held-out pairs; only instrumental melody transplanted; same archived renderer and backing; no selection by model score.

model_input.input: The exact normalized first-chorus listening excerpts
model_input.audiobox: Existing evaluator over the complete excerpt
model_input.clap: Existing frozen prompt manifest; --segments 1; centered ten-second window
model_input.limitations: Neither model directly measures groove, memorability, or whole-song quality

clap_preprocessing.normalization: none; native CLAP clips to [-1,1] and quantizes to int16
clap_preprocessing.window_selection: equally spaced first-to-last complete window; one segment uses center
clap_preprocessing.aggregation: unweighted mean of valid excerpt cosines

audiobox_model.scoring: Existing aesthetics.py score function unchanged; model handles 10-second windows across complete WAV, duration-weighted final partial window.

subjective.note: No new human listening rating is inferred or reused for these candidate renders.

validation.ruff_directory: Four pre-existing findings in unchanged tools/eval/tune.py; changed files pass.
